title: cracca micheliana
intro: Cracca micheliana, commonly known as Michel's clover or Bird's foot trefoil, is a perennial herb in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders, such as irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Cracca micheliana include its ability to stimulate appetite, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
